Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to check whether a given year is a Leap Year or Not a Leap Year. 
Input Description:
The program should accept a single integer Y (year) as input. 
Output Description:
The program should print "Leap Year" if Y is divisible by 4 and (not divisible by 100 or divisible by 400). 
Otherwise, print "Not a Leap Year". 
Sample Input:
2020 
Sample Output:
Leap Year 
Explanation:
A year is a leap year if: 
It is divisible by 4. 
If it is divisible by 100, it must also be divisible by 400 to be a leap year.
